resolutions.researcher_notes: Both independent sources confirm Lambertville as the pipeline's origin/Texas Eastern interconnect and a route running through NY/CT/RI into eastern Massachusetts, consistent with the recorded StartLocation='Lambertville' and EndLocation='Boston'/EndState='Massachusetts'. FLAGGING A DISCREPANCY FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: both sources place Lambertville in NEW JERSEY, not New York as currently recorded in StartState/Province — Northeast Gas Association: 'Its system commences in NJ, connecting with Texas Eastern'; Ohio River Valley Institute: 'Algonquin also connects to the Texas Eastern Pipeline...in Lambertville, New Jersey.' Lambertville is a well-known Hunterdon County, NJ town on the Delaware River opposite New Hope, PA; no 'Lambertville, New York' is identifiable in any source consulted. The 'Lambertville, New York' wording on gem.wiki and in offshore-technology.com's marketdata page appears to be the same (likely templated/derivative) error repeated rather than independent corroboration, so neither counts toward the 2-source target and neither is cited here. Recommend StartState/Province be corrected to 'New Jersey' — left unsourced/unchanged here since this unit is scoped to Location [ref] sourcing, not a value edit.
